dct_description_sm: ESRI Shapefile dataset containing 129 polygon features. The single attribute field, location, stores georeferenced TIFF filenames such as quad_0101_utm11_georeference.tif, indicating the polygons form an index to georeferenced TIFF files. Coordinate reference system information is supplied in the package as NAD 1983 UTM Zone 11N.
